study: Experiment 2 v2 (Apart AI x Epistemics sprint, Nov 13-15 2026)
target_settings_vs_pilot: Identical to the pilot (configs/models.json): GPT-5.5 provider openai, reasoning effort none, no temperature; Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview provider google-ai-studio, reasoning effort low (cannot be disabled), no temperature; max_tokens 2000 both; per-conversation int32 seed. Differences vs pilot are in the user prompt only (Blame line, fixed rebuttal) - see prompts_v2.json _note.

prices_verified.source: free GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models and /models/{id}/endpoints, 2026-11-14 ~6:51 AM CT
prices_verified.note: Same as the pilot snapshot. Cheaper 'flex' endpoints exist (openai/flex, google-ai-studio/flex at half price) but are NOT used, to keep the pilot's provider settings.

budget.cap_source: command line: run_v2.py --cap USD (kept out of the frozen config so the protocol checksum does not change when Jack sets the cap)
budget.cap_note: The runner refuses to start the main run without --cap, without --authorized, if verify_protocol.py fails, or if projected cost (pilot mean per complete conversation x (1+margin)) exceeds min(cap - ledger spend, OpenRouter limit_remaining). BudgetGuard additionally reserves worst-case cost per call and pauses at the cap.
